claims.statement: For every finite Boolean function under every interior product measure and every physical block A, L_A=M_A+J_A and 0<=J_A<=M_A+Delta_A(p).
The universal claim J_A<=M_A fails for the two-bit AND sign gate at p=1/8,q=1/4 by more than 0.1195 bits.
evidence: source-bound repaired certificate blobs c3adb486..., 0a6917fe..., d3db5bd0...

claims.statement: M,J,L,Delta add for exact product functions on disjoint variable sets with aligned revealed blocks.
The supplied exact tensor calculation does not prove a single-use M,J,Delta transfer through arbitrary Boolean compositions.
claims.gap: An interface to the O'Donnell-Tan biased FEI+ cocycle is absent; shared variables are excluded.

claims.statement: For g(X,Y)=(-1)^(XY), reveal X, P(X=1)=p->0 and fixed 0<q=P(Y=1)<1/2, J-M=[4q(1-2q)+o(1)]p log2(1/p); at q=1/4 the coefficient is 1/2.
claims.consequence: No uniform O(p) correction can replace the rare logarithmic tax.
